reviewCharts.warning: Texas native review rows use Capitol Data Portal VTD-level 2024 General Election President-versus-U.S. Senate rows. Certified county result rows remain sourced from Texas SOS County.json. The VTD presidential rows aggregate to 11,404,528 votes, 15,854 above the SOS county certified-result package total of 11,388,674. Reconciliation shows the gap is primarily a write-in scope difference: VTD rows include 24,730 generic Write-In votes, while SOS certified county rows include 8,569 named declared write-in candidate votes. Use VTD rows as official local screening context rather than replacement certified totals.

historicalBaselines.warning: Texas historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with state-source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
